THE 1ˢᵗ VR SCI-FI NARRATIVE FILM in the NEW IMMERSIVE CINEMA FORMAT (8K 180VR-3D), The Talent Stealer™ is an Award-Winning & Spectacular Sci-Fi Action-Thriller that achieves NEW LEVELS of Entertainment & Sophistication in VR Filmmaking - with an incredible concept and story in the vein of The Matrix, Inception, X-Men and Nikita:
 
At a secret facility called The Maxstein Institute, a group of students are controlled and trained to master their special memory & skill-stealing abilities by a shadowy organization with morally ambiguous goals. One student is singled out for her extraordinary power, and finds herself in a fight for her freedom and her sanity from those that wish to control her

Starring actors Breanna Watkins (The Predator, Sonic) and Jared Payne (The Last of Us Se.2)


Specially engineered to combine elements of 2D Cinema with the new 3D-180 Immersive Video format, viewers can truly feel like they have "stepped inside" a Hollywood movie for the VERY FIRST TIME - experiencing Cinema standards of lighting, music, VFX and editing for a complex narrative story flow and "little to no" motion sickness.

The Talent Stealer is the first Chapter in a series of Chapters coming soon (further TRAILER included!)

*SPATIAL AUDIO upgrade soon



*Film contains scenes with flashing lights and not suitable for photosensitive viewers.
